name: Thesis
description: Bachelor/Master/PhD thesis: introduction, state of the art, contribution and architecture, implementation, experimental evaluation, conclusions.

sections.title: Abstract
sections.objective: Summarise problem, contribution, method and main results in one page.

content.markdown: _Context and problem → goal of the thesis → approach → main results → significance. Write it last._

sections.title: Introduction
sections.objective: Introduce the problem, motivate it and state goals and contributions of the thesis.

children.title: Context
children.objective: Describe the domain in which the thesis is set.

content.markdown: _The application domain and the technological/scientific landscape, from general to specific._

children.title: Motivation and Problem Statement
children.objective: Explain why the problem matters and define it precisely.

content.markdown: _What is the problem, who is affected, why existing solutions are not enough._

subs.title: Research questions / goals
subs.objective: Each question/goal must be answered in the evaluation and conclusions.

children.title: Contributions
children.objective: List the original contributions of the thesis.

content.markdown:
1. [Design of …]
2. [Implementation of …]
3. [Experimental evaluation showing …]

children.title: Thesis Structure
children.objective: Give a roadmap of the chapters.

content.markdown: Chapter 2 presents the state of the art. Chapter 3 describes the proposed contribution and its architecture. Chapter 4 details the implementation. Chapter 5 reports the experimental evaluation. Chapter 6 concludes and outlines future developments.

sections.title: State of the Art
sections.objective: Provide the background and critically review existing work related to the problem.

children.title: Background
children.objective: Introduce the concepts, technologies and terminology needed to follow the thesis.

content.markdown: _Definitions, models, standards and technologies used later._

children.title: Related Work
children.objective: Review existing approaches, grouped by theme.

content.markdown: _One subsection per research line: summary, strengths, limitations._

subs.title: Comparison
subs.objective: Makes the gap explicit and motivates the contribution.

content.markdown:
| Approach | Feature A | Feature B | Limitation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Work 1] | ✓ | ✗ | [...] |
| **This thesis** | ✓ | ✓ | — |

children.title: Open Challenges
children.objective: Summarise the gaps that the thesis addresses.

content.markdown:
- [Gap 1 → addressed in Chapter 3]
- [Gap 2 → addressed in Chapter 5]

sections.title: The Contribution / Architecture
sections.objective: Present the proposed solution at the conceptual and architectural level.

children.title: Requirements

content.markdown:

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

children.objective: Describe the overall architecture and its main components.

children.title: Design Decisions
children.objective: Justify the key design choices against alternatives.

content.markdown: _For each decision: alternatives considered, criteria, choice and consequences._

sections.objective: Explain how the architecture was realised in practice.

children.objective: Describe the most relevant parts of the implementation.

subs.objective: Only code that helps understanding; full code goes in the repository.

content.markdown: _Responsibilities, main data structures and interactions of each key module._
